title: Remove shallow cache allowed function NOW?
description: Stops new shallow caches from referencing function NOW.
statements: ALTER READYSET DROP SHALLOW CACHE ALLOWED FUNCTION `NOW`;
undo: ALTER READYSET ADD SHALLOW CACHE ALLOWED FUNCTION `NOW`;
checks: Refresh the Readyset place to inspect the current caches, tables and status.
The Audit log keeps this attempt as Outcome unknown; nothing is sent again.

policy.title: Risky write
policy.text: Connection Readyset lab is a Development connection. myflames asks only before risky writes, and this statement is one.
